claim: Simplify the _keys mechanism in CB.Belief: drop the whole-array churn-suppression rationale (moot once writes are per-file), retaining only absent-vs-null round-trip fidelity if still needed.

evidence.detail: Discharged 2026-07-06: the churn-suppression rationale is moot per-file - Store.write skips byte-identical node files, so no whole-array rewrite exists to stabilize. _keys is retained solely for absent-vs-null round-trip fidelity, which per-node files still need (from_map_roundtrips? holds against the split graph); the store and adjudication docs no longer cite array churn as its purpose.
